Trace, implement and test: LCP 09. 最小跳跃次数

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    int minJump(vector<int>& jump) {
        int n = jump.size();
        vector<bool> vis(n + 1);
        queue<int> q{{0}};
        vis[0] = true;
        int ans = 0, mx = 1;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            for (int t = q.size(); t; --t) {
                int i = q.front();
                int j = i + jump[i];
                if (j >= n) return ans + 1;
                q.pop();
                if (!vis[j]) {
                    vis[j] = true;
                    q.push(j);
                }
                for (j = mx; j < i; ++j) {
                    if (!vis[j]) {
                        vis[j] = true;
                        q.push(j);
                    }
                }
                mx = max(mx, i + 1);
            }
            ++ans;
        }
        return -1;
    }
};
